prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 11 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1001; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a collision sustained while turning left, when the vehicle was struck from the side. Complaints centered on neck and low back pain with associated stiffness and muscle tightness. The mechanism of impact and the forces involved are consistent with the soft tissue injuries reported. Over the course of eleven visits, treatment consisted of manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction, and followed a typical progression. Care was gradually reduced in frequency as symptoms improved and range of motion returned. On examination, paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical rotation were noted and support the reported injury. Other neurological and orthopedic screening tests were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving these same body regions. Note that two similar billing entries dated the same day are currently under review for accuracy and are not yet resolved.
